source: Keep the native write, sharp double, reference dimers, appointments, shot budget and complete acquisition. Modify only the two-dimensional coin-even, signed, balanced subspace of the tagged 99-state generator. binding_only restores the unit parity term at (1,1) and leaves the contrast energy switched off there. pause_only restores 4*kappa there and leaves the parity term switched off. Together with native and always_ticking these exhaust the two independent switches.
read: At all 97 appointments retain both sign quadratures, quiet and both reference positions. For binding_only check a rate of one on the same deep even-parity surface. For pause_only report the unconditional tag probabilities, quadrature visibility and final principal phase; infer no isolated eigenfrequency without a complement gap.
